Source: Which art each icon is. Tools/Icons/place_icons.py copies every file here to Assets/Secure/Icons/<category>/<slug>.png, where Tools/SecureArt/SetupSecureArt.eval.cs makes it the Addressables entry icon/<category>/<slug> in Protected_Icons (see SecureArtAddresses). Skills are keyed by Skills.json Key, spells and racial abilities by name, weapon abilities by name, prompts by '<device>-<Input System control name>'. Skill, spell and ability art was chosen by eye from the 6000 Fantasy Icons pack, opaque-background ('standard') files only, one file per icon. Synty's interface icons are transparent glyphs, so they are not used here. Items are keyed by Items.json Type; the pack's item pictures have clear backgrounds, so place_icons.py lays them on black, and an {art, hue} entry is recoloured in a crafting material's hue (wood, leather, hides, scales, granite share one picture each). Items not listed keep the rendered picture of their model (ItemIcons); spell scrolls show their spell's icon.
